name: AIDA particle face
description: Traced from the AIDA reference portrait. Coordinates are in source-image pixels (950x702). points: flat [x0,y0,x1,y1,...]; edges: flat [a0,b0,a1,b1,...] indices into points; dots: indices of points drawn as larger node dots; mouthWeights: per-point weight (0-1) for how far the point moves down when the mouth opens.
